name: AFR 9939 中断起飞 刹车超温

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 939, a flight from Wuhan to Beijing, you are parking at gate 07, you have received information Hotel, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 939，从武汉飞往北京，停在07号登机口，已收到通播Hotel，向武汉放行申请空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR9939, gate 07, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR9939，07号登机口，通播H，申请前往北京的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 939, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure runway 18, Zulu Foxtrot 02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，按计划航路放行至北京，18跑道离场，ZF 02离场，初始爬升2700米，航路中申请改平，离场频率127.35，squawk 2615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure runway 18, ZF 02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至北京，18跑道离场，ZF 02离场，初始爬升2700米，航路中申请改平，离场频率127.35，squawk 2615，AFR9939。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR9939, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR9939，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 939, push back and start up approved, facing east.
B: Tell the controller you have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, you want to change the push back position in face west.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，可以推出和开车，机头向东。告诉管制员，强顺风下发动机启动有困难，希望改为机头向西的推出位置。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, but we have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, request change the push back position in face west, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，但强顺风下发动机启动有困难，申请改为机头向西推出，AFR9939。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up procedures, you are ready for taxi, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车程序，准备好滑行，请申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR9939, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR9939，推出和开车已完成，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 939, taxi to holding point runway 18 via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha and Alpha 1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR9939。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 939, hold at present position, give way to Airbus 320 vacating via Echo 5.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，在当前位置等待，让行经E5脱离的Airbus 320。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, traffic in sight, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前位置等待，看到冲突飞机，AFR9939。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 939, traffic is clear, continue taxi via Alpha and Alpha 1 to holding point runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，冲突已解除，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point runway 18, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR9939。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 939, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Alpha 1, runway 18, you have completed pre-takeoff checklist, you are ready for takeoff, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在A1等待点、18跑道，起飞前检查单已完成，准备好起飞，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, holding point A1, runway 18, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR9939，A1等待点，18跑道，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 939, line up runway 18.
C: Air France 939, cleared for takeoff runway 18, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，18跑道可以起飞，地面静风。

cards.audioText: B: During takeoff role, you notice an Airbus 320 is crossing your runway, you aborted takeoff, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑过程中，你发现一架Airbus 320正在穿越你的跑道，你中断起飞，请向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, we aborted takeoff due an A320 crossing runway 18.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR9939，因一架A320穿越18跑道，我们中断起飞。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 939, what is the situation like now?
B: Tell the controller your brakes have exceeded the temperature limit, and request taxi back to apron to have the plane checked.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：Air France 939，现在情况如何？
告诉管制员刹车已超过温度限制，并申请滑回机坪检查飞机。
cards.referenceText: Our brakes are overheating, request taxi back to apron for check, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们刹车过热，申请滑回机坪检查，AFR9939。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 939, expedite vacate via Echo 1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 939，尽快经E1脱离。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 939, do you need any assistance?
B: Tell the controller you need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：Air France 939，你需要任何协助吗？
告诉管制员需要客梯车让旅客下机。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 需要，我们需要客梯车让旅客下机，AFR9939。
